lines.en: Each step sinks the soil.

lines.zh: 四条腿撑着巨大的身体。
lines.en: Four legs carry this great bulk.
The canopy parts over my back.
The canopy sways at my shoulder.
I shift along with the herd.
I snapped a sapling underfoot.
My steps bend the grass.

lines.zh: 地面上的坑是我的脚印。
lines.en: The pits in the ground are my prints.
Walk, pause, take a few mouthfuls.
I squeeze sideways between two trees.

lines.zh: 丛林在我的重量下闷响。
lines.en: The jungle groans under my weight.
The grass parts around me.
I walk deeper, step by step.
Soil squeezes away under my feet.
Standing, chewing slowly.
I stretch my neck for leaves.
The forest wind is pleasant.
Standing, I'm like a wall.
The herd grazes behind me.
I turn my head slowly around.
My breath stirs the grass.
I don't need to move.
This tree will feed me till tomorrow.
I push aside a fern with my snout.
My legs are like four pillars.
I blow out hot breath.
Leaves settle on my back.

lines.zh: 我在听有没有大的动静。
lines.en: Listening for anything large.
You reach only my foreleg.

lines.zh: 我的长脖子挡住了阳光。
lines.en: My long neck blocks the sun.
One step takes me to you.
You shouldn't stand so close.
I eat a lot, but not you.
You smell of tree sap.
I lower my head slowly to look.
My tail will sweep you.
Best stay out of my path.
I mean no harm. I'm just heavy.
I must lower my head to see you.

lines.zh: 你脚下这块地是我的路。
lines.en: That ground under you is my path.
My foot sank, and I steadied.
The flesh under my thick hide tingles.
Thick hide, but it still hurts.

lines.zh: 血顺腿上滑下来，皮很厚。
lines.en: Blood slides down my leg; the hide is thick.
Blood runs down my leg.
I can still stand steady.
I lower my head to look.
The herd is all watching me.
I blow out a heavy breath.
I let out a deep, low bellow.

lines.zh: 我除了叶子什么都不吃。
lines.en: I eat nothing but leaves.
That branch is too low.
I never eat fruit.
Hand it over. I can reach.
That's less than one mouthful.
I want the whole branch.
Hold it a little higher.
My mouth is too big to fill.
It smells edible.
You can stand further off.
You hit my thigh.
I barely noticed.
Back up. I'm shifting my foot.
You're where my foot lands.
I'll pause and let you pass.
My body is too wide.
My tail's coming. Duck.
That'll shove you aside.
I'll try to step around you.
We nearly collided.
The herd arranges that.

lines.zh: 我现在的力气都用在吃上。
lines.en: All my strength goes to eating.

lines.zh: 我只想找一个安静的同伴。
lines.en: I only want a quiet companion.
My size makes that awkward.
There are others deeper in the forest.
I'll wait out this season.
I don't discuss herd matters.

lines.zh: 你最好别问巨兽这种问题。
lines.en: Don't ask a giant such things.
I go back to the leaves.

lines.zh: 这件事对我来说太轻了。
lines.en: That matter is too light for me.
My flat beak reaches it.

lines.zh: 我这副鸭嘴，吃得动整片林子。
lines.en: This duckbill can eat a whole grove.
It won't fit in my mouth.
A stone. I can't eat it.
Bending down is a chore.
It's tiny beside my feet.
I flattened it.
Not worth bending for.
I'll kick it over to you.
Fern leaves suit my appetite.
I heard something in the trees.
I plant all four legs.
The herd is bunching up.

lines.zh: 慢慢转过身，尾巴扫过草。
lines.en: Turning slowly, tail sweeping grass.
I'm not afraid of this at all.
One step is enough.
I shift my weight to my hind legs.
Something stirs at the treeline.
I'm between this and the young.

lines.zh: 两道热气从我鼻孔涌出。
lines.en: Two warm gusts pour from my nostrils.
First I plant my feet.
My body lies across the forest path.
I've taken my position.
It's in the herd's path.
It's still there, unmoving.
I turn my bulk across the path.

lines.zh: 我的脚步震得落叶直跳。
lines.en: My steps make the leaves jump.
It has backed off two or three steps.
Turning takes me time.
The trees can't stop me.
I'm in no hurry. I'm very large.

I swing my tail to cut off its retreat.

One step closer and I drop on it.
It isn't running quickly at all.
Let's see if it's afraid.
I lower my head, snout closing in.
The herd follows behind me.
It's coming toward me.
I turn my body across the way.
I brought my forelegs down.
My forelegs slam the ground.
A swing of my head flicks it off.
The hit sent you stumbling back.
The ground sinks where I step.
I butted with my head.
I step down and it leaps clear.
My knee caught it.
That only grazed the skin.

lines.zh: 丛林的路，我的身宽就够堵。
lines.en: My bulk alone blocks the jungle path.
I crowd it against the tree.
Its weapon touched my hide.
I press, and it can only retreat.
A swing of my head knocks it aside.
That one used my whole weight.
It slipped out between my legs.
I rise out of the tree shadow.
My head pushes through the canopy.
This forest will feed me a while.
The herd's noise is nearby.
I test the soil underfoot.
Leaves still cling to my back.

lines.zh: 我把脖子伸向第一棵树。
lines.en: I reach my neck to the first tree.
My shadow darkens the grass.
I lower my head for a mouthful of leaves.
These trees aren't very tall.

lines.zh: 我一落地，土就震了一下。
lines.en: The ground jolted as I landed.
Something's moving — the grass shakes.
I must find water first.
The smells here are unfamiliar.
I settle my body and stand firm.
The grass flattens under my feet.
Fire singed the hair on my legs.

lines.zh: 我摔在地上，砸出一个坑。
lines.en: I fell and left a crater.
The river is at my shoulder.
The blast bursts by my legs.
A point sank into the hide.

lines.zh: 那光在脖子上绕了一圈。
lines.en: That light circled my neck.

lines.zh: 这附近的树都被我吃秃了。
lines.en: I've stripped the trees around here.

lines.zh: 雷劈在我背上，焦了一片。
lines.en: Lightning struck my back and scorched it.

lines.zh: 这么沉的腿也踩不到地。
lines.en: Even these legs find no ground.
